It's sharp enough to cut through almost anything, so it may have been used to forge new routes.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 45 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Battle Axe+}} Ancient Battle Axes+ are [[Weapon]]s wielded by [[Guardian Scout III|Guardian Scouts III]] in "A Moderate Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s. When the {{BotW|-}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], a [[Treasure Chest]] containing an Ancient Battle Axe+ has a chance to spawn. They are improved versions of [[Ancient Battle Axe]]s that deal more damage. Due to their sharpness, it is theorized they may have been used to forge paths. The sixth weapon [[Nebb]] will ask [[Link]] to show him during "[[The Weapon Connoisseur]]" [[Side Quest]] is the Ancient Battle Axe+, which he claims are not common around [[Hateno Village]].{{Cite|Have you ever heard of an {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient battle axe+}}? Grandpa said you can't find those around here. If you get ahold of one, let me see it|Nebb|BotW}} If Link brings him one, Nebb will be excited and give him a [[Silver Rupee]] as a sign of his gratitude.{{Cite|Isn't that...an {{Color BotW|Blue|ancient battle axe+}}? So cool! Let me see!|Nebb|BotW}}{{Cite|Thanks for lettin' me see! Take this as a thank you!|Nebb|BotW}} Since they are made using [[Ancient Technology]], Ancient Battle Axes+ will deal more damage when they are used to fight Guardians. They will not burn when exposed to a [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], nor will they be able to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. They do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]], but they will float if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Ancient Battle Axes+ are part of the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a collection of Weapons that are wielded by [[Guardian Scout]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_014" |Life = 20 |Power = 45 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.3 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 35 |BuyingPrice = 84 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Ancient Battle Axe+ Inactive Model.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Inactive Ancient Battle Axe+ File:AoC Ancient Battle Axe+ Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Ancient Battle Axe+ ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Battle Axe * Ancient Battle Axe++ * Ancient Weapon * Guardian Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Ancient Weapons, Axes, Guardian Gear, Two-Handed Weapons, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
